Big 12 Conference Softball Tournament
The Big 12 Softball Tournament (sometimes known simply as the Big 12 Championship) was the conference championship tournament in college softball for the Big 12 Conference (Big 12). Since its inception in 1996, the tournament was played at ASA Hall of Fame Stadium in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The winner received the conference's automatic bid to the NCAA Division I Softball Tournament. The Big 12 stopped holding a postseason conference tournament after the 2010 competition. In 2017, the Big 12 Conference stated that they would be holding a tournament starting in 2017. The tournament will still be hosted at ASA Hall of Fame Stadium in Oklahoma City.
